parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].template: set protocols cfm interface [parameter1] cfm enable
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].command: set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.1 cfm enable
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].explanation: 在指定接口上启用CFM（Connectivity Fault Management）。

set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].template: set protocols cfm interface [parameter1] cfm md [parameter2]
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].command: set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.1 cfm md md1

set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].template: set protocols cfm interface [parameter1] cfm ma [parameter2]
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].command: set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.1 cfm ma ma1

set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].template: set protocols cfm interface [parameter1] cfm mep mep-id [parameter2]
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].command: set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.1 cfm mep mep-id 1
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].explanation: 配置CFM的维护端点（Maintenance End Point）。

set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].template: set protocols cfm interface [parameter1] cfm mep mep-id [parameter2] interface [parameter3] [parameter4]
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].command: set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.1 cfm mep mep-id 1 interface ge-0/0/1.1 inward
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].explanation: 配置维护端点的方向为向内。

set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].template: set protocols cfm interface [parameter1] cfm mep mep-id [parameter2] ccm-send enable
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].command: set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.1 cfm mep mep-id 1 ccm-send enable
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].explanation: 启用维护端点的CCM（Continuity Check Message）发送功能。

set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].template: set protocols cfm interface [parameter1] cfm remote-mep mep-id [parameter2]
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].command: set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.1 cfm remote-mep mep-id 2

set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].template: set protocols cfm interface [parameter1] cfm remote-mep mep-id [parameter2] ccm-receive enable
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].command: set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.1 cfm remote-mep mep-id 2 ccm-receive enable
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].explanation: 启用远程维护端点的CCM接收功能。

set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].template: set protocols cfm interface [parameter1] cfm test-id [parameter2] mep [parameter3] remote-mep [parameter4]
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].command: set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.1 cfm test-id 1 mep 1 remote-mep 2
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].explanation: 配置CFM测试ID，关联本地和远程维护端点。

set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].template: set protocols cfm interface [parameter1] cfm loss-measurement dual-ended continual test-id [parameter2]
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].command: set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.1 cfm loss-measurement dual-ended continual test-id 1
set protocols cfm interface [parameter1].explanation: 配置双端持续丢包测量。

parameters.name: lsr-id
parameters.explanation: LSR ID，通常为设备的环回地址。

set protocols ospf area [parameter1] int.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/1.1
set protocols ospf area [parameter1] int.explanation: 在指定区域中启用OSPF协议的接口。

set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parame.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan-id [parameter3]
set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parame.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan-id 2
set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parame.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换VLAN ID。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parame.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parame.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/24
set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parame.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces [parameter1] family inet.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 family inet address 10.1.1.1/24
set interfaces [parameter1] family inet.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。
